title: Exact coherent group presentations and canonical weight operators
statement: Let $F,T,Z,X,R$ and coherent linearizations be as in [def-sfb-trivial-torus-coherent-data], with coherence as in [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $G_0(Z)$ be the quotient of the free abelian group on coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-modules by isomorphism relations and $[B]-[A]-[C]$ for every short exact sequence $0\to A\to B\to C\to0$. Let $G_0^T(Z)$ have the analogous equivariant isomorphism and equivariant short exact sequence relations. Its $R$-action is character twist: equivalently present it by the free $R$-module on coherent linearizations, with those relations and $[M(\chi)]-e^\chi[M]$. Twisting means multiplying the forward action by $\chi(t)$. Tensor products use the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with pullback comparisons [def-pc-module-pullback] normalized on pure tensor sections. Exterior powers use [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], with pullback comparisons normalized on wedge sections and with action on each wedge factor. A tensor operator is an additive (respectively $R$-linear) endomorphism sending every generator $[A]$ to $[E\otimes A]$. A character comparison is an $R$-linear isomorphism $R\otimes_{\mathbf Z}G_0(Z)\simeq G_0^T(Z)$ sending $e^\chi\otimes[A]$ to the pure-character class of $A$. Restriction is tensor pullback with the induced forward action through the canonical composition comparison. A pulled-back weight decomposition uses the actual pulled-back inclusion maps, with their monomorphism, coproduct and scalar-weight properties. Open subspaces and field base changes are the canonical open schemes and scheme pullbacks over $F$.
